label: sub_032_ecology_02
text: Congratulations on winning the Academy Ace\nTournament.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_03
text: I sure am proud to have one of my students\nbecome the academy’s ace![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_04
text: Ah, don’t worry, Director Clavell. I’ll get to the\npoint now.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_05
text: I’m actually calling to tell you that highly difficult\nTera Raids are cropping up all over the place.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_06
text: We’re getting report after report from academy\nstudents about their Pokémon getting injured.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_07
text: We teachers have split up to investigate these\nraids, but we’re still a bit shorthanded.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_08
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sooo, we were wondering if we could enlist your\nhelp, since you’re the academy’s ace and all.\r\nHow about it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_select_02
text: If I can find the time...

label: sub_032_ecology_10
text: Your Pokédex automatically records the data we\nneed as you go, so don’t worry about that![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_11
text: For now, I’d like you to just take on a lot of these\ntough Tera Raid Battles![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_12
text: But don’t get in over your head. Even the\nacademy’s ace needs to be careful![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_032_ecology_13
text: I sure would be sad if one of my precious\nstudents got injured.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
